newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Q4 wage trend data due on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Q4 wage trend data due on Wednesday.

text.p: The Department of Industrial Relations said on Monday it would release its December quarter wage trends in enterprise bargaining report on Wednesday.
The report shows average annualised wages based on wage agreements covering employees in the private and public sectors.
Enterprise bargaining agreements are negotiated on an individual employer basis rather than on an industry-wide scale.
The report will be released at 0030 GMT (11.30 a.m.)
